geeklist.description:
[b][size=18]Auction has closed to bids. I will be sending geekmails over the next few days to the winners.[/size][/b]
[b]Important rules for bidders! [/b]
Local Pickup Bidders are allowed to bid any amount (but read further on bids below the soft reserve). [b]Bidders requiring shipping can only use the BIN w Shipping option when bidding. [b]Buyer is responsible for paying the shipping costs.[/b] Please pay attention to this rule![/b]
Timing for bids. Read Carefully!
The first day the auction is posted, Sunday, November 9th , will be for people to look over the items so they can be organized, decide what item(s) they may be interested in, and be prepared when the auction opens for bidding. No bidding allowed the first day(and a good part of the 2nd day)! This will give you time to carefully (please!) read all the information in the header! Also a chance to shoot me any questions prior to bidding beginning.
Bidding begins on the second day, Monday, November 10th, beginning at 7 PM Eastern Time. For this day ONLY LOCAL PICKUP BIDDERS MAY BID INCLUDING THE BIN OPTION. I am giving them priority use of the BIN because local pickup is just so much easier for me. I apologize ahead of time for this. I have used it before and was happy with its effects.
The 3rd day, Tuesday, November 11th, beginning at 7 PM Eastern Time, BIN bidding will be open to everyone (that is USA addresses only).
Finally my anti sniping rules (let's be nice!) :
Normal bidding continues until Thursday, November 13th, at 7 PM Eastern Time. At this time the auction will pause until 9 AM Eastern time on the following day, Friday, November 14th. When bidding resumes, only BIN bids will be accepted. The auction will end at 4 PM Eastern Time that same day, Friday, November 14th.
[b]Finally a last comment about the auctions listings, which is clearly stated on the last around 100 items. These items are for local bidders only.[/b]
If any of these rules is unclear to you, shoot me a note!
My crazy times call for drastic measures auction! Getting to a certain age (that's my excuse and I am sticking to it) where things have gotten slightly out of hand! More out than In is the new battle cry! I have pulled good and valuable (or not) stuff from my shelves and closets. Everything goes (hopefully) Help a guy out (make my wife happy) and find some games here that I know you have been looking for! 300 (!) items to consider!
I tried to organize by item category. Many items fit into more than one so it was a toss up where to put things. In general you will find similar items listed together but you will also see things pop up in unexpected places! To give you a heads up, here is a general structure of the listings:
Euros, Wargames, Small Box Games, Card Games (with many hard to find, foreign, and out of print - holiday shopping), ending with an eclectic mix of bigger box games and older games. The last 100 or so games that are only available for local buyers contain many lots of multiple games and some big box items that I will not be shipping.
My pricing philosophy - I try to put low soft reserve bids (!) and BIN prices that are reasonable. You may disagree and that is fine! Please respect my right to price games as I see fit. Any winning bid lower than the Soft Reserve will be considered on a case by case basis. Please bid accordingly.
All items described to the best of my ability. I use BGG pics to reference editions, these are not pics of the actual games being sold. Unless otherwise stated in the item listing, all games are in very good to excellent condition, from a pet free, smoke free home. If the box condition is a concern to you, ask about it before bidding.
All games are either English Editions, Multi Language with English Editions or have an English Rules Translation in the box. If not it will be stated in the listing. If you receive an item that you think was misrepresented, contact me and we will work something out. Please think before bidding so that you can keep impulse bidding under control, I want happy customers!
Quick Rules PLEASE READ BEFORE BIDDING!!!
Place bid by using the comment section for each item.
Bid in whole US Dollar increments.
Buy It Now Option bid will end the auction on that item immediately.
Please place zip code for shipping or one of the local pickup options next to your bid.
No unsold items will be sold after the auction closes. Please do not ask to purchase items that do not have a bid after the auction ends.
I will not sell / trade / pull items out from under bidders that have bid on a particular item. That is just not cool! (The only reason an item will be pulled is I have made a mistake in the listing.)
No conditional bids will be considered, ie I bid x dollars for this item only if my bid of y dollars wins a different item.
Shipping to USA only. [b]Buyer is responsible for paying the shipping costs.[/b] I am on the East Coast, Rhode Island, so if you are west of that big river running through our country, living in one of those big square states, perhaps over next to that other ocean way far from me, remember that shipping could get pricey! Shipping anywhere that requires a large box could get pricey. Please consider these costs before bidding. I have started using pirateship which makes shipping costs considerably better.
A better choice: Local Pickup. I live in RI so if you live near there we can probably meet up. I also get to some of the local gatherings so hand off at these events is considered "Local". Here are choices:
EllisCon - Saturday, November 15th, 9 AM to 9 PM, in Danielson, North East corner of Connecticut. I will be there the whole day so can hand off games there. Come play some games! I will probably also bring some of the games that did not sell (if you go and see something that did not sell send me a geekmail).
Southern RI. I live in South Kingstown, home of the best university in the state, Go Rams! So for you people upstate, local pickup means packing a lunch and driving down here!
Meetup of The Wakefield Boardgamers. This happens on a Saturday mid month. The date is usually posted on BGG.
Meetup at The German Club in Providence, 2nd Thursday night of the month. I usually attend.
Meetup in Milford, MA, 1st Saturday of the month. I usually attend but check.
TotalCon in Marlborough, MA, middle of the February. I will be there Wednesday thru Sunday. I will hold games for you until then if you would like.
I am a one man operation so please be patient, I will get to you asap. Organizing and shipping will be a major challenge. I do have things organized (and retired so my main focus over the next few weeks following the auction will be getting things out) but the logistics will require a certain amount of time. If you will have a problem of waiting for possibly 2 weeks, or more, please do not bid! Thanks in advance.
I have sold games for many years, here and on ebay - you can check my rating on that site as I am user kamf there.
I will send geekmail to all winners after the auction concludes. (Again be patient!). For BGG cut, I will sum the winning bids and make 4 continuing bulk listings for November, December, January, and February, as items are sold and transactions completed.
Payment by Paypal for items shipped (Friends preferred but have no problem with the sales and services choice), Money Order, Personal checks (will clear before I ship). I will want cash for any items picked up in person.
Does that cover everything? If not shoot me a geekmail.
Bid early! Bid Often! Be Nice!
geeklist.comment:
Let the games begin! Local bidders can start now. Those requiring shipping start tomorrow.
Find more auctions listed in the Metalist of geek auctions here :
https://boardgamegeek.com/geeklist/66420/metalist-for-geeklist-auctions

Hi regarding the BIN w/ shipping - what if we bid on multiple games, will you adjust the shipping price for consolidated total shipping cost once that is determined? Or is the flat BIN shipping upcharge no matter how many items? Thank you for running a large auction (and allowing time to view the items first, that's neat!) I do recognize it is a lot of work. :)

I will ship all games together. I will get a quote from piratship. Winning bidders are responsible for shipping costs. It is not a flat charge. Those that require shipping will pay the shipping BIN plus shipping costs. Sorry if that was not clear.
BIN Bidding with Shipping begins shortly about 45 minutes!

The auction is going well. Thanks for all the interest.
I would like to see more of the games sell so am updating the rules, primarily to make it a little more friendly to those that require shipping.
No changes for today, November 13. (Friday the 13th falls on a Thursday this month) Auction will pause at 7 PM. This means for today Local BIN bidders have one last day to pay less than BIN bidders requiring shipping. Bidders requiring shipping bidding today will pay the higher BIN price.
Update on BIN bids for tomorrow, November 14. (Friday the 13th falls on the 14th this month?) :
Local BIN prices will not change. [b][size=18]BIN bids requiring shipping bid on November 14 will be reduced to the Local BIN price.[/size][/b] Important reminder - The last about 80 items in the auction clearly marked Local Sales will still remain only available for local pickup.
Remember today's rules do not change! (However to be fair to those who have chosen BIN with shipping [b]prior to this posting[/b], I will retroactivity apply this rule to their bids as they bid in good faith the higher price.)
As mentioned in the header, tomorrow, November 14, bidding will resume at 7 AM Eastern Time, at which time only BIN bids will be accepted. The auction will close tomorrow at 4 PM Eastern Time.
Hope this is clear to all. Good luck on the last 2 days of the auction!
Bidding is paused until tomorrow at 7 AM Eastern Time. When bidding resumes , only BIN bids will be accepted.

Last Day! Auction ends at 4 PM. Today only BIN bids are allowed and all BIN bids, including those requiring shipping, will be at the lower (Local) BIN price.
Good luck and thanks for all the bids.
